analysis_notes.eitza_edge_summary: One eitza edge found: פורים → פסח (Purim is the pathway/דרך to Pesach).

node_disposition.פורים: Already assigned to Package 1 (מָרְדֳּכַי וְחֵרוּת) via additions file. Purim is the festival of Mordechai's victory and structurally parallel to the freedom/חרות cluster.
node_disposition.פסח: Already assigned to Package 3 (שְׂפָתַיִם וּפֶסַח) via bechina packages. Pesach is identified with speech (פה סח) and the lips (שפתותיו).

analysis_notes.structural_note: The single eitza edge connects Package 1 (Mordechai/Freedom/Purim) to Package 3 (Lips/Pesach/Speech), reflecting the Torah's core argument: Purim is the preparatory pathway (הִלּוּךְ וְדֶרֶךְ) that leads to Pesach. This is the directional flow of the teaching — from the concealment and lottery of Purim to the revealed speech of Pesach.
analysis_notes.torah_completeness_note: This Torah is explicitly incomplete ('וּפָסַק בְּאֶמְצַע הָעִנְיָן וְלֹא גִּלָּה יוֹתֵר'). The sparse edge count (1 eitza edge) reflects an unfinished teaching, not missing data.
